subject: feat(ssh_dotnet): add private-key file/passphrase connection properties (XML+CSV)
body:
feat(ssh_dotnet): add private-key file/passphrase connection properties (XML+CSV)

Add two SSH_DotNet connection properties (Phase 6 of the cert-login feature):
 - SshDotNetPrivateKeyFile      : path to a private key (plaintext, like other paths)
 - SshDotNetPrivateKeyPassphrase: secret, encrypted at rest like Password
   (PasswordPropertyText masking in the grid; gated on the SaveFilter.SavePassword).

Wired across every persistence touch-point: AbstractConnectionRecord (+ backing
fields), ConnectionInfoInheritance (inherit flags, auto-registered via reflection),
XML serializer/deserializer, CSV serializer/deserializer (header+value+inherit
columns), and Language.resx/Designer localization. SQL backend intentionally skipped
(matches the existing SSH_DotNet precedent).

Tests: the reflection-driven XmlSerializationLifeCycleTests auto-covers the round
trip (verified: +12 passing parameterised cases, 0 new failures vs baseline). Added
3 explicit security tests: passphrase encrypted-at-rest + decrypts back, passphrase
blanked when SavePassword is off, and key-file stored plaintext + round-trips.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Serialization for SshDotNet private-key properties; entire SshDotNet protocol absent from our fork (we use PuTTY for SSH). No target for these fields.
